headline: Ghana Banking Industry Non-Performing Loans Fall to 13.1%
summary: Ghana's banking industry non-performing loan ratio declined to 13.1% in October 2026 from 19.5% a year earlier, supported by a rebound in credit and reduced problem loans.
why: Non-performing loan ratios serve as a primary gauge of banking sector health and credit risk, impacting commercial bank lending capacity and financial stability.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: A lower non-performing loan ratio indicates strengthening credit portfolios across commercial banks.
